primary_comparison: Mean model-judged reference-answer F1 across all 23 supported questions. Genuine supported-question refusals count as zero; missing judgments on answered questions make this comparison incomplete.
baseline: Retain existing compatible section-based 30-case run; fixed and semantic are new executions. All results use the same current prompt and evaluation contracts. Section precision was previously reassessed on its original saved answers.
limitations: One sequential execution per chunker on synthetic, source-derived examples; no statistical significance or controlled warm latency guarantee. Different run times and machine loads may affect timing. Do not change models, prompts, references, top-k or corpus during comparison.
